site.name: AI Utility Belt
site.tagline: Private tools for AI costs, tokens and prompts
site.description: Free, private tools for AI work: forecast costs, compare model prices, count tokens, trim prompts and clean documents. Everything runs in your browser.

tools.name: Cost Forecaster
tools.desc: Forecast monthly LLM costs for chatbots, agents and batch jobs.
tools.tag: Monthly cost of chatbots and agents
tools.when: You are planning a chatbot, agent or batch job and need a monthly budget.

tools.name: Model Prices
tools.desc: Compare LLM API prices per million tokens and context windows across providers, updated daily.
tools.title: LLM API Pricing Comparison: Prices & Context Windows
tools.when: You want to look up or compare what a model costs per million tokens.

tools.name: Model Picker
tools.desc: Shortlist LLMs by monthly cost, context size and provider for your own workload. Enter a typical request and compare live prices.
tools.title: LLM Model Picker: Shortlist by Monthly Cost
tools.when: You know a typical request size and volume and need a shortlist of models.

tools.name: Price Change Tracker
tools.desc: See which LLM API prices were cut or raised, and which models were added or removed, from our daily price snapshots.
tools.title: LLM API Price Change Tracker
tools.when: You want to see which prices were cut or raised and which models were added or removed.

tools.name: Failover Cost Estimator
tools.desc: Estimate the extra cost of running on a backup LLM during an outage, and compare backup options by price and context size.
tools.title: LLM Failover Cost Estimator
tools.tag: Cost of running on a backup model
tools.when: You are planning for an outage and want to know what a backup model would cost.

tools.name: Token Counter
tools.desc: Count tokens and check whether your text fits a model's context window.
tools.when: You have a prompt or document and need its size and whether it fits a context window.

tools.name: PDF & Web to Text
tools.desc: Turn PDFs and web pages into clean, LLM-ready text.
tools.tag: PDF or web page to clean text
tools.when: You want to paste a document into a chatbot without headers, page numbers and broken lines.

tools.name: AI Text Cleaner
tools.desc: Strip Markdown, invisible characters and em dashes.
tools.when: Text copied from an AI chat has Markdown symbols, invisible characters or em dashes you want gone.

tools.name: Text Chunker
tools.desc: Split long documents into overlapping, token-sized chunks and test which chunk answers a question.
tools.when: You are building document search and need token-sized chunks with overlap.

tools.name: Chat Export
tools.desc: Convert ChatGPT and Claude chats to Markdown, Word or PDF.
tools.tag: Save chats as Markdown, Word, PDF
tools.when: You want to keep a ChatGPT or Claude conversation as a document.

tools.name: Prompt Builder
tools.desc: Reusable prompt templates with variables, saving and share links.
tools.when: You send the same kind of prompt again and again and want a template to fill in.

tools.name: Prompt Token Optimizer
tools.desc: Cut filler and repeats from long prompts, review every change, and see what it saves.
tools.when: A long prompt costs too much and you want to cut wording safely.

tools.name: JSON Validator
tools.desc: Validate model output against a simple schema.
tools.when: A model returned JSON and you need to know whether it is valid and has the right fields.

tools.name: JSON Repair
tools.desc: Fix broken JSON from AI models: trailing commas, single quotes, code fences and cut-off output, with every change listed.
tools.title: JSON Repair and Formatter for AI Output
tools.when: A model's JSON will not parse: it has trailing commas, code fences or single quotes, or was cut off.
